evidence.abstract:
We study the special algebraic properties of alternating 3-forms in 6 and 7
                                                 dimensions and introduce a diffeomorphism-invariant functional on the space
                                                 of differential 3-forms on a closed manifold M in these dimensions. Restricting
                                                 the functional to a de Rham cohomology class in H 3 (M, R), we find that a
                                                 critical point which is generic in a suitable sense defines in the 6-dimensional
                                                 case a complex threefold with trivial canonical bundle and in 7 dimensions a
                                                 Riemannian manifold with holonomy G2 . This approach gives a direct method
                                                 of showing that an open set in H 3 (M, R), with a special geometry, is a local
                                                 moduli space for these structures.
